mutable struct TestContext
    result_path::String
    f::IO
end

function _output(name::String)
    result_path = string(ENV["TEST_TMPDIR"], "/", name)
    f = open(result_path, "w")
    ctx = TestContext(result_path, f)
    return ctx
end

function _generate_diff(actual::String, expected::String)::String
    actual_lines = split(actual, '\n')
    expected_lines = split(expected, '\n')
    diff_lines = String[]
    push!(diff_lines, "--- expected")
    push!(diff_lines, "+++ actual")
    for i in 1:max(length(actual_lines), length(expected_lines))
        if i <= length(expected_lines) && i <= length(actual_lines)
            if expected_lines[i] != actual_lines[i]
                push!(diff_lines, string("- ", expected_lines[i]))
                push!(diff_lines, string("+ ", actual_lines[i]))
            end
        elseif i <= length(expected_lines)
            push!(diff_lines, string("- ", expected_lines[i]))

function _make_restype_rigidgroup_dense_atom_idx()
    base_atom_indices = zeros(Int32, NUM_RESTYPES_WITH_UNK_AND_GAP, 8, 3)
    
    for (restype, restype_letter) in enumerate(PROTEIN_TYPES_ONE_LETTER)
        resname = PROTEIN_COMMON_ONE_TO_THREE[restype_letter]
        dense_atom_names = ATOM14[resname]
        
        base_atom_indices[restype, 1, :] = [findfirst(==(atom), dense_atom_names) for atom in ["C", "CA", "N"]]
        base_atom_indices[restype, 4, :] = [findfirst(==(atom), dense_atom_names) for atom in ["CA", "C", "O"]]
        
        for chi_idx in 1:4
            if CHI_ANGLES_MASK[restype][chi_idx] == 1
                atom_names = get(CHI_ANGLES_ATOMS, resname, [])
                if chi_idx <= length(atom_names)
                    base_atom_indices[restype, chi_idx + 4, :] = [findfirst(==(atom), dense_atom_names) for atom in atom_names[chi_idx][2:4]]
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    dense_atom_names = DENSE_ATOM["A"]
    nucleic_rigid_atoms = [findfirst(==(atom), dense_atom_names) for atom in ["C1'", "C3'", "C4'"]]
    
    for (nanum, _) in enumerate(NUCLEIC_TYPES)
        resnum = nanum + NUM_AA_WITH_UNK_AND_GAP
        base_atom_indices[resnum, 1, :] = nucleic_rigid_atoms
    end
    
    return base_atom_indices
end

const RESTYPE_RIGIDGROUP_DENSE_ATOM_IDX = _make_restype_rigidgroup_dense_atom_idx()

function _make_restype_pseudobeta_idx()

    for (restype, restype_letter) in enumerate(PROTEIN_TYPES_ONE_LETTER)
        restype_name = PROTEIN_COMMON_ONE_TO_THREE[restype_letter]
        atom_names = collect(ATOM14[restype_name])
        
        if restype_name == "GLY"
            restype_pseudobeta_index[restype] = findfirst(==("CA"), atom_names)
        else
            restype_pseudobeta_index[restype] = findfirst(==("CB"), atom_names)
        end
    end
    
    for (nanum, resname) in enumerate(NUCLEIC_TYPES)
        atom_names = collect(DENSE_ATOM[resname])
        restype = nanum + NUM_AA_WITH_UNK_AND_GAP
        
        if resname in ["A", "G", "DA", "DG"]
            restype_pseudobeta_index[restype] = findfirst(==("C4"), atom_names)
        else
            restype_pseudobeta_index[restype] = findfirst(==("C2"), atom_names)
        end
    end
    
    return restype_pseudobeta_index
end

const RESTYPE_PSEUDOBETA_INDEX = _make_restype_pseudobeta_idx()

function _make_aatype_dense_atom_to_atom37()
    restype_dense_atom_to_atom37 = []
    
    for rt in PROTEIN_TYPES_ONE_LETTER
        atom_names = collect(ATOM14_PADDED[PROTEIN_COMMON_ONE_TO_THREE[rt]])
        append!(atom_names, fill("", NUM_DENSE - length(atom_names)))
        push!(restype_dense_atom_to_atom37, [haskey(ATOM37_ORDER, name) ? ATOM37_ORDER[name] : 0 for name in atom_names])
    end
    
    for _ in 1:(2 + length(NUCLEIC_TYPES) + 1)
        push!(restype_dense_atom_to_atom37, zeros(Int32, NUM_DENSE))
    end
    
    restype_dense_atom_to_atom37 = hcat(restype_dense_atom_to_atom37...)'
    
    return Array{Int32}(restype_dense_atom_to_atom37)
end

const PROTEIN_AATYPE_DENSE_ATOM_TO_ATOM37 = _make_aatype_dense_atom_to_atom37()

using LinearAlgebra

function _make_atom_has_clash_mask(kd_query_result::Vector, struc::Any, ignore_chains::Set{String})::BitVector
    atom_is_clashing = falses(struc.num_atoms)
    
    for (atom_index, clashes) in enumerate(kd_query_result)
        chain_i = struc.chain_id[atom_index]
        
        if chain_i in ignore_chains
            continue
        end
        
        islig_i = struc.is_ligand_mask[atom_index]
        
        for clashing_atom_index in clashes
            chain_c = struc.chain_id[clashing_atom_index]
            
            if chain_c in ignore_chains
                continue
            end
            
            islig_c = struc.is_ligand_mask[clashing_atom_index]
            
            if clashing_atom_index == atom_index || chain_i == chain_c || islig_i != islig_c
                continue
            end
            
            atom_is_clashing[atom_index] = true
        end
    end
    
    return atom_is_clashing
end

function find_clashing_chains(struc::Any; clash_thresh_angstrom::Float64=1.7, clash_thresh_fraction::Float64=0.3)::Vector{String}
    if !(0 < clash_thresh_fraction <= 1)
        error("clash_thresh_fraction must be in range (0,1]")
    end
    
    struc_backbone = filter_polymers_to_single_atom_per_res(struc)
    
    if struc_backbone.num_chains == 0
        return String[]
    end
    
    if !any(struc_backbone.coords .!= 0)
        return String[]
    end
    
    using NearestNeighbors
    coord_kdtree = KDTree(struc_backbone.coords')
    
    clashing_per_atom = inrange(coord_kdtree, struc_backbone.coords', clash_thresh_angstrom)
    
    chain_ids = struc_backbone.chains
    
    if !isnothing(struc_backbone.atom_occupancy)
        chain_occupancy = Float64[]
        for (start_idx, end_idx) in iter_chain_ranges(struc_backbone)
            push!(chain_occupancy, mean(struc_backbone.atom_occupancy[start_idx:end_idx]))
        end
    else
        chain_occupancy = nothing
    end
    
    chains_to_remove = Set{String}()
    
    for _ in 1:length(chain_ids)
        atom_has_clash = _make_atom_has_clash_mask(clashing_per_atom, struc_backbone, chains_to_remove)
        
        clashes_per_chain = Float64[]
        for (start_idx, end_idx) in iter_chain_ranges(struc_backbone)
            push!(clashes_per_chain, mean(atom_has_clash[start_idx:end_idx]))
        end
        
        max_clash = maximum(clashes_per_chain)
        
        if max_clash <= clash_thresh_fraction
            break
        end
        
        most_clashes = findall(==(max_clash), clashes_per_chain)
        
        if !isnothing(chain_occupancy)
            occupancy_clashing = chain_occupancy[most_clashes]
            last_lowest_occupancy = length(occupancy_clashing) - argmin(reverse(occupancy_clashing))
            worst_and_last = most_clashes[last_lowest_occupancy]
        else
            worst_and_last = most_clashes[end]
        end
        
        push!(chains_to_remove, chain_ids[worst_and_last])
    end
    
    return sort(collect(chains_to_remove))
end

function largest_evec(m::AbstractArray)
    eigvals, eigvecs = eigen(Symmetric(m))
    return eigvecs[:, end]
end

function largest_evec_jvp(primals, tangents)
    m = primals[1]
    t = tangents[1]
    
    eigvals, eigvecs = eigen(Symmetric(m))
    large_eigvec = eigvecs[:, end]
    large_eigval = eigvals[end]
    other_eigvals = eigvals[1:end-1]
    other_eigvecs = eigvecs[:, 1:end-1]
    
    other_ev_times_tangent = other_eigvecs' * t
    
    nominator = other_ev_times_tangent * large_eigvec
    
    prefactor = nominator ./ max.(large_eigval .- other_eigvals, 1e-6)
    
    grad = sum(prefactor .* other_eigvecs, dims=2)
    
    return large_eigvec, grad
end

const MATRIX_SVD_QUAT_FACTORS = make_matrix_svd_factors()

mutable struct Vec3Array{T}
    x::T
    y::T
    z::T
end

function normalized(v::Vec3Array)
    norm_val = sqrt(v.x^2 + v.y^2 + v.z^2)
    return Vec3Array(v.x / norm_val, v.y / norm_val, v.z / norm_val)
end

function dot(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array)
    return v1.x * v2.x + v1.y * v2.y + v1.z * v2.z
end

function cross(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array)
    return Vec3Array(
        v1.y * v2.z - v1.z * v2.y,
        v1.z * v2.x - v1.x * v2.z,
        v1.x * v2.y - v1.y * v2.x
    )
end

mutable struct Rot3Array{T}
    xx::T
    xy::T
    xz::T
    yx::T
    yy::T
    yz::T
    zx::T
    zy::T
    zz::T
end

function inverse(rot::Rot3Array)
    return Rot3Array(rot.xx, rot.yx, rot.zx, rot.xy, rot.yy, rot.zy, rot.xz, rot.yz, rot.zz)
end

function apply_to_point(rot::Rot3Array, point::Vec3Array)
    return Vec3Array(
        rot.xx * point.x + rot.xy * point.y + rot.xz * point.z,
        rot.yx * point.x + rot.yy * point.y + rot.yz * point.z,
        rot.zx * point.x + rot.zy * point.y + rot.zz * point.z
    )
end

function apply_inverse_to_point(rot::Rot3Array, point::Vec3Array)
    return apply_to_point(inverse(rot), point)
end

function Base.:*(rot1::Rot3Array, rot2::Rot3Array)
    c0 = apply_to_point(rot1, Vec3Array(rot2.xx, rot2.yx, rot2.zx))
    c1 = apply_to_point(rot1, Vec3Array(rot2.xy, rot2.yy, rot2.zy))
    c2 = apply_to_point(rot1, Vec3Array(rot2.xz, rot2.yz, rot2.zz))
    return Rot3Array(c0.x, c1.x, c2.x, c0.y, c1.y, c2.y, c0.z, c1.z, c2.z)
end

function identity_rot(shape, dtype=Float32)
    ones_arr = ones(dtype, shape)
    zeros_arr = zeros(dtype, shape)
    return Rot3Array(ones_arr, zeros_arr, zeros_arr, zeros_arr, ones_arr, zeros_arr, zeros_arr, zeros_arr, ones_arr)
end

function from_two_vectors(e0::Vec3Array, e1::Vec3Array)
    e0 = normalized(e0)
    c = dot(e1, e0)
    e1 = normalized(Vec3Array(e1.x - c * e0.x, e1.y - c * e0.y, e1.z - c * e0.z))
    e2 = cross(e0, e1)
    return Rot3Array(e0.x, e1.x, e2.x, e0.y, e1.y, e2.y, e0.z, e1.z, e2.z)
end

function from_array(array::AbstractArray)
    return Rot3Array(
        array[..., 1, 1], array[..., 1, 2], array[..., 1, 3],
        array[..., 2, 1], array[..., 2, 2], array[..., 2, 3],
        array[..., 3, 1], array[..., 3, 2], array[..., 3, 3]
    )
end

function to_array(rot::Rot3Array)
    row1 = hcat(rot.xx, rot.xy, rot.xz)
    row2 = hcat(rot.yx, rot.yy, rot.yz)
    row3 = hcat(rot.zx, rot.zy, rot.zz)
    return cat(row1, row2, row3, dims=1)
end

function from_quaternion(w, x, y, z; normalize::Bool=true, epsilon::Float64=1e-6)
    if normalize
        inv_norm = 1.0 / sqrt(max(epsilon, w^2 + x^2 + y^2 + z^2))
        w *= inv_norm
        x *= inv_norm
        y *= inv_norm
        z *= inv_norm
    end
    
    xx = 1 - 2 * (y^2 + z^2)
    xy = 2 * (x * y - w * z)
    xz = 2 * (x * z + w * y)
    yx = 2 * (x * y + w * z)
    yy = 1 - 2 * (x^2 + z^2)
    yz = 2 * (y * z - w * x)
    zx = 2 * (x * z - w * y)
    zy = 2 * (y * z + w * x)
    zz = 1 - 2 * (x^2 + y^2)
    
    return Rot3Array(xx, xy, xz, yx, yy, yz, zx, zy, zz)
end

function from_svd(mat::AbstractArray; use_quat_formula::Bool=true)
    @assert size(mat)[end] == 9
    
    if use_quat_formula
        symmetric_4by4 = reshape(MATRIX_SVD_QUAT_FACTORS * mat, (4, 4))
        largest_eigvec = largest_evec(symmetric_4by4)
        return inverse(from_quaternion(largest_eigvec...))
    else
        mat_reshaped = reshape(mat, (3, 3))
        U, S, Vt = svd(mat_reshaped)
        det_uv_t = det(U * Vt)
        diag_array = [1.0, 1.0, det_uv_t]
        diag_times_v_t = diag_array .* Vt
        out = U * diag_times_v_t
        return from_array(out)
    end
end

function random_uniform(rng::AbstractRNG, shape, dtype=Float32)
    quat_array = randn(rng, dtype, (shape..., 4))
    return from_quaternion(quat_array[..., 1], quat_array[..., 2], quat_array[..., 3], quat_array[..., 4])
end

function pseudo_beta_fn(aatype::AbstractArray, dense_atom_positions::AbstractArray, dense_atom_masks::AbstractArray; is_ligand::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing, use_jax::Bool=true)
    if isnothing(is_ligand)
        is_ligand = zeros(eltype(aatype), size(aatype))
    end
    
    pseudobeta_index_polymer = RESTYPE_PSEUDOBETA_INDEX[aatype .+ 1]
    
    pseudobeta_index = ifelse.(is_ligand .!= 0, zeros(Int32, size(pseudobeta_index_polymer)), pseudobeta_index_polymer)
    
    pseudo_beta = similar(dense_atom_positions, size(dense_atom_positions)[1:end-2]..., 3)
    for i in eachindex(pseudobeta_index)
        idx = pseudobeta_index[i]
        pseudo_beta[i, :] = dense_atom_positions[i, idx, :]
    end
    
    pseudo_beta_mask = similar(dense_atom_masks, size(dense_atom_masks)[1:end-1])
    for i in eachindex(pseudobeta_index)
        idx = pseudobeta_index[i]
        pseudo_beta_mask[i] = dense_atom_masks[i, idx]
    end
    
    return pseudo_beta, pseudo_beta_mask
end

function _create_jax_precision_map()
    precision_map = Dict()
    
    for ((dtype, jax_precision), dot_precision) in _JAX_GPU_PRECISION_MAP
        precision_map[("gpu", dtype, jax_precision)] = dot_precision
    end
    
    for ((dtype, jax_precision), dot_precision) in _JAX_CPU_PRECISION_MAP
        precision_map[("cpu", dtype, jax_precision)] = dot_precision
    end
    
    return precision_map
end

function get_equivalent_dot_precision(a_dtype::Symbol, b_dtype::Symbol, jax_precision::Symbol)::DotPrecisionEnum
    if a_dtype != b_dtype
        error("Cannot infer precision if operand types differ.")
    end
    
    backend = lowercase(string(Sys.CPU_NAME))
    backend = contains(backend, "gpu") || contains(backend, "cuda") ? "gpu" : "cpu"
    
    if jax_precision != :DEFAULT && a_dtype != :float32
        error("`jax.lax.Precision` values other than `DEFAULT` only have an effect if the operand type is `float32`.")
    end
    
    return _JAX_PRECISION_MAP[(backend, a_dtype, jax_precision)]

        rot.xx .* point.x .+ rot.xy .* point.y .+ rot.xz .* point.z,
        rot.yx .* point.x .+ rot.yy .* point.y .+ rot.yz .* point.z,
        rot.zx .* point.x .+ rot.zy .* point.y .+ rot.zz .* point.z
    )
end

function apply_inverse_to_point(rot::Rot3Array, point::Vec3Array)
    return apply_to_point(inverse(rot), point)
end

function to_array(rot::Rot3Array)
    row1 = hcat(rot.xx, rot.xy, rot.xz)
    row2 = hcat(rot.yx, rot.yy, rot.yz)
    row3 = hcat(rot.zx, rot.zy, rot.zz)
    return cat(row1, row2, row3, dims=1)
end

function from_array(array::AbstractArray)
    return Rot3Array(
        array[1, 1], array[1, 2], array[1, 3],
        array[2, 1], array[2, 2], array[2, 3],
        array[3, 1], array[3, 2], array[3, 3]
    )
end

function from_svd(mat::AbstractArray)
    mat_reshaped = reshape(mat, (3, 3))
    U, S, Vt = svd(mat_reshaped)
    return Rot3Array(
        U[1, 1] * Vt[1, 1] + U[1, 2] * Vt[2, 1] + U[1, 3] * Vt[3, 1],
        U[1, 1] * Vt[1, 2] + U[1, 2] * Vt[2, 2] + U[1, 3] * Vt[3, 2],
        U[1, 1] * Vt[1, 3] + U[1, 2] * Vt[2, 3] + U[1, 3] * Vt[3, 3],
        U[2, 1] * Vt[1, 1] + U[2, 2] * Vt[2, 1] + U[2, 3] * Vt[3, 1],
        U[2, 1] * Vt[1, 2] + U[2, 2] * Vt[2, 2] + U[2, 3] * Vt[3, 2],
        U[2, 1] * Vt[1, 3] + U[2, 2] * Vt[2, 3] + U[2, 3] * Vt[3, 3],
        U[3, 1] * Vt[1, 1] + U[3, 2] * Vt[2, 1] + U[3, 3] * Vt[3, 1],
        U[3, 1] * Vt[1, 2] + U[3, 2] * Vt[2, 2] + U[3, 3] * Vt[3, 2],
        U[3, 1] * Vt[1, 3] + U[3, 2] * Vt[2, 3] + U[3, 3] * Vt[3, 3]
    )
end

mutable struct Rigid3Array{T}
    rotation::Rot3Array{T}
    translation::Vec3Array{T}
end

function Base.:*(rigid1::Rigid3Array, rigid2::Rigid3Array)
    new_rotation = rigid1.rotation * rigid2.rotation
    new_translation = apply_to_point(rigid1.rotation, rigid2.translation)
    new_translation = Vec3Array(
        new_translation.x .+ rigid1.translation.x,
        new_translation.y .+ rigid1.translation.y,
        new_translation.z .+ rigid1.translation.z
    )
    return Rigid3Array(new_rotation, new_translation)
end

function inverse(rigid::Rigid3Array)
    inv_rotation = inverse(rigid.rotation)
    neg_trans = Vec3Array(-rigid.translation.x, -rigid.translation.y, -rigid.translation.z)
    inv_translation = apply_to_point(inv_rotation, neg_trans)
    return Rigid3Array(inv_rotation, inv_translation)
end

function apply_to_point(rigid::Rigid3Array, point::Vec3Array)
    rotated = apply_to_point(rigid.rotation, point)
    return Vec3Array(
        rotated.x .+ rigid.translation.x,
        rotated.y .+ rigid.translation.y,
        rotated.z .+ rigid.translation.z
    )
end

function apply_inverse_to_point(rigid::Rigid3Array, point::Vec3Array)
    new_point = Vec3Array(
        point.x .- rigid.translation.x,
        point.y .- rigid.translation.y,
        point.z .- rigid.translation.z
    )
    return apply_inverse_to_point(rigid.rotation, new_point)
end

function compose_rotation(rigid::Rigid3Array, other_rotation::Rot3Array)
    rot = rigid.rotation * other_rotation
    return Rigid3Array(rot, rigid.translation)
end

function identity_rigid3(shape, dtype=Float32)
    return Rigid3Array(identity_rot3(shape, dtype), zeros_vec3(shape, dtype))
end

function scale_translation(rigid::Rigid3Array, factor)
    return Rigid3Array(
        rigid.rotation,
        Vec3Array(rigid.translation.x .* factor, rigid.translation.y .* factor, rigid.translation.z .* factor)
    )
end

function to_array(rigid::Rigid3Array)
    rot_array = to_array(rigid.rotation)
    vec_array = to_array(rigid.translation)
    return hcat(rot_array, vec_array)
end

function from_array(array::AbstractArray)
    rot = from_array(array[:, 1:3])
    vec = from_array(array[:, 4:4])
    return Rigid3Array(rot, vec)
end

function from_array4x4(array::AbstractArray)
    if size(array)[end-1:end] != (4, 4)
        error("array.shape($(size(array))) must be [..., 4, 4]")
    end
    
    rotation = Rot3Array(
        array[1, 1], array[1, 2], array[1, 3],
        array[2, 1], array[2, 2], array[2, 3],
        array[3, 1], array[3, 2], array[3, 3]
    )
    
    translation = Vec3Array(array[1, 4], array[2, 4], array[3, 4])
    
    return Rigid3Array(rotation, translation)
end

function _compute_covariance_matrix(row_values::Vec3Array, col_values::Vec3Array, weights::AbstractArray; epsilon::Float64=1e-6)
    weights = broadcast(identity, weights)
    
    out = []
    
    weights_sum = sum(weights, dims=length(size(weights)))
    normalized_weights = weights ./ (weights_sum .+ epsilon)
    
    weighted_average(x) = sum(normalized_weights .* x, dims=length(size(x)))
    
    push!(out, hcat(
        weighted_average(row_values.x .* col_values.x),
        weighted_average(row_values.x .* col_values.y),
        weighted_average(row_values.x .* col_values.z)
    ))
    
    push!(out, hcat(
        weighted_average(row_values.y .* col_values.x),
        weighted_average(row_values.y .* col_values.y),
        weighted_average(row_values.y .* col_values.z)
    ))
    
    push!(out, hcat(
        weighted_average(row_values.z .* col_values.x),
        weighted_average(row_values.z .* col_values.y),
        weighted_average(row_values.z .* col_values.z)
    ))
    
    return vcat(out...)
end

function weighted_mean(value::Vec3Array, weights::AbstractArray; axis::Int=-1)
    weights_sum = sum(weights, dims=axis)
    normalized_weights = weights ./ (weights_sum .+ 1e-6)
    
    return Vec3Array(
        sum(normalized_weights .* value.x, dims=axis),
        sum(normalized_weights .* value.y, dims=axis),
        sum(normalized_weights .* value.z, dims=axis)
    )
end

function from_point_alignment(points_to::Vec3Array, points_from::Vec3Array; weights=nothing, epsilon::Float64=1e-6)
    if isnothing(weights)
        weights = 1.0
    end
    
    points_to_center = weighted_mean(points_to, weights, axis=-1)
    points_from_center = weighted_mean(points_from, weights, axis=-1)
    
    centered_points_to = Vec3Array(
        points_to.x .- points_to_center.x,
        points_to.y .- points_to_center.y,
        points_to.z .- points_to_center.z
    )
    
    centered_points_from = Vec3Array(
        points_from.x .- points_from_center.x,
        points_from.y .- points_from_center.y,
        points_from.z .- points_from_center.z
    )
    
    cov_mat = _compute_covariance_matrix(centered_points_to, centered_points_from, weights, epsilon=epsilon)
    
    rots = from_svd(reshape(cov_mat, size(cov_mat)[1:end-2]..., 9))
    
    rotated_from_center = apply_to_point(rots, points_from_center)
    translations = Vec3Array(
        points_to_center.x .- rotated_from_center.x,
        points_to_center.y .- rotated_from_center.y,
        points_to_center.z .- rotated_from_center.z
    )
    
    return Rigid3Array(rots, translations)
end
